How it works

You pre-register, we organise

No upfront payment: the group sets off when it reaches the minimum number of participants. If it does not go ahead, you pay nothing.

1Choose and write to us

Find the tour and pre-register with a message on WhatsApp or through the form.

2We reach the group

We usually need about 20 people. We let you know as soon as it is confirmed.

3We set off

At least 7 days before, we tell you the date and the pick-up points that suit the participants.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Where do I get on the coach?

Pick-up points are chosen according to the participants: Mentana, Monterotondo, Fonte Nuova, Sant'Angelo Romano and Rome.

What is included?

Each page says what is included (coach, guide, hotel) and what is not (entrance fees, meals). The prices shown are starting prices.

Can I book my own group?

Yes: groups, schools and companies get a dedicated quote. Ask for a quote.

What happens if the tour does not go ahead?

If the minimum number of participants is not reached, the tour does not go ahead and you pay nothing.
